description:
From the moment you step into the main living area, the feeling is immediate--open, airy, and unmistakably well-done. The kitchen, dining, and living areas flow together across a single connected floor finished with stunning wood-look porcelain tile, creating the kind of space that feels both expansive and effortlessly livable. The finishes throughout are modern, cohesive, and genuinely high-end--this is not a cosmetically updated condo. It's been done right.

The kitchen commands attention: sweeping quartz countertops with subtle grey veining, grey shaker soft-close cabinetry, a walk-in pantry, a peninsula, a 5-burner stainless steel range, and refined touches like a touch-activated faucet and a dedicated reverse osmosis tap. The primary bathroom matches that energy--a walk-in shower with standard, rain, and handheld showerheads behind a glass enclosure; a built-in soaking tub; a double vanity; a dedicated makeup vanity; and a private water closet, all finished in sleek white tile with grey cabinetry throughout.

The two-story layout gives the home a townhouse-like quality rarely found in condo living--bedrooms fully separated from living spaces, each floor with its own private building entrance and its own independently controlled heating and AC. Both bedrooms have walk-in closets, with the primary's being especially generous. A gas fireplace, in-unit washer and dryer, and a private patio round out the interior.

The building offers two elevators, a pool, and a jacuzzi, with two side-by-side parking spaces in the secured underground garage and ample visitor parking. Steps from Ventura Boulevard and minutes from Balboa Park--with effortless access to the best of Los Angeles: dining, entertainment, culture, and everything the city has to offer
